page.notes: Doubtful readings: "reperculsus" is read as printed, with the line-end break at "reper-/cussione"; the word "cussione" carries a faint superscript mark that may be a printer's stroke, read here as plain "cussione". The word "fuste" is clear in the scan. No marginal notes, no reference marks, no footnotes. The initial "S" of "SI quæras" is a larger capital, transcribed as printed. The catchword "tiones" is the completion of "demonstra-" at the foot of the page.
